name: Tobias Cremer - Projet de recommandation (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning an enhanced EU-Canada cooperation in the light of the current geopolitical context, including the threats to Canada’s economic stability and sovereignty
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the EU to work much more closely with Canada. It wants joint action on defence, trade, energy, the Arctic and support for Ukraine. It also wants the EU and Canada to defend international rules and institutions together. The report is a set of recommendations, not a new law. It calls on the EU Council, the European Commission and the EU foreign policy chief to act.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament recommends closer EU-Canada cooperation on defence, trade and the Arctic.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, EU institutions, Canadian authorities, businesses and workers in both places.
- **What happens next:** The Council, Commission and foreign policy chief decide whether to act on these recommendations.
